summary.name: TouchRetouch
summary.one_liner: TouchRetouch is an AI-powered mobile photo editing app for removing unwanted objects, people, and lines from photos, plus retouching and background tools.
use_cases: Removing unwanted objects or people from a photo
Removing a watermark from an image
Cutting out or changing a photo background
Improving color and sharpness of pictures
Adding shadows or effects to product photos
summary.what_it_does: The page describes TouchRetouch as a pocket app that uses AI to remove unwanted objects, people, or lines from photos. It also offers face and skin retouching, background blur, background removal, and watermark removal. According to the page, the user picks a tool, selects an area, and the app automatically analyzes the photo and applies settings. Other listed functions include color correction, adding shadows or effects, and enhancing image quality and sharpness.
notable: Pick a tool, select an area, and the AI handles the edit automatically
One app covering object removal, retouching, background tools, and quality enhancement
Listed in eudk/awesome-ai-tools under AI tools for photo editing
caveats: Pricing and supported platforms are not stated on the page
Page is mostly marketing text with few concrete technical details
